questions.qtext: In an extrinsic n-type semiconductor, which of the following schematic diagram depicts the variation of the fermi energy level (EF) with temperature (T)?
questions.solution:
(d)
For an n-type semiconductor, the Fermi level is close to the conduction band. As the temperature increases, minority carrier concentration increases and the Fermi level moves towards the center of the forbidden gap in both p-type and n-type semiconductors. At T = Tc (curie temperature), minority carrier concentration will become equal to majority carrier concentration and the extrinsic semiconductor will become intrinsic semiconductor.

questions.qtext: Which of the following are the correct statements regarding MOS capacitor structure with a ptype substrate at high-signal frequency of operation?

options.text: The differential change in charge occurs at metal and oxide interface.
The differential change in charge occurs at metal and space charge width of substrate.
Capacitance of MOS capacitor reaches maximum.
The inversion layer charge will not respond to a differential change in capacitor voltage.

questions.solution:
(b, d)
At high frequency operation of MOS capacitor, the inversion layer charge will not be able to respond to a differential change in capacitor voltage. The differential change in charge occurs at the metal and in the space charge width in the semiconductor. For high frequency conditions, the capacitance per unit area measured in inversion is the series combination of oxide capacitance per unit area and capacitance per unit area of the depletion region. Furthermore, since, the depletion width reaches a maximum value, the capacitance of the MOS capacitor is at the minimum value, Cmin.
